rep-9901.record_type: Cardiac Troponin I & High-Sensitivity CRP Panel

payload.summary: Troponin-I within normal baseline (<0.01 ng/mL). hs-CRP slightly elevated at 2.4 mg/L indicating mild systemic inflammatory response.
payload.clinicalImpression: No evidence of acute myocardial injury. Recommend lifestyle interventions for mild inflammatory elevation.
payload.recommendations: Repeat hs-CRP test in 6 weeks. Maintain balanced diet and 150 mins weekly cardiovascular activity.
